## Decision-integrity boundary

Describe the timestamp, provenance, replay, review, audit, or reporting behavior
that changes.

## Evidence

- [ ] positive reference fixture added or updated
- [ ] adversarial fixture added or updated
- [ ] generated artifacts refreshed
- [ ] hard gates were not weakened to improve a score
- [ ] historical rules remain prospective and immutable
- [ ] no personal data, credential, or private decision record
- [ ] `python tools/release_gate.py` passes
